author: Sevoo
body:
Alright I'm going to give out a couple of points that just need to be said.

To all those people making forum posts about "bugs" or "you made a mistake" or "it's too laggy", is it me, or am I recalling multiple "when is Atlas coming" threads and complaints before it came out? I understand that they shouldn't have released it with this much lag and bugs, but for fucks sake just suck it up and wait for it to be fixed. At this point it's safe to say the developers mostly know what's going on so just report a bug on GitHub and be done with it. Sorry if I sound too harsh but this is pissing me off.

Second, to the developers, in all honesty the server is unplayable right now and I had to make an effort to try and bear it for more than five minutes without saying "what the fuck" out loud. I know you guys are trying to fix everything and I'm not really going to blame you guys for all of this but my suggestion is keep Avicus on beta access and only let Staff join the server. Because if the server is public for more than 2-3 days after this expect an increase in complaints and leaving threads (these last two words are retarded and pretty stupid people are leaving because of temporary lag but anyways). 

Thanks.

replies.author: Elly
replies.body:
Unfortunately, this wouldn't be a very effective method for developing new features out of a collection of updates. For example, you could have implementations in Avicore and Atlas that seemingly do the same exact thing, but are completely different internally. The code that has been rewritten for Atlas, while also adding new features, is also much more efficient and dynamic. This will help a lot in the future, when we want to add more things to the plugin that may not have been previously feasible with Avicore.

Say we wanted to convert YML to XML for maps. This is a fairly independent feature, however we couldn't really break it up. We can't base half of the map on YML and the other half on XML, so we would have to make the change all at once. Of course, this would lead to unprecedented issues. In the most recent case that I can recall, this is similar to the nonexistent time limit issue that has happened on Competitive all day.

While it would be nice to follow a sort of rolling release type of feature addition, the whole idea of Atlas was a complete rewrite. This field beta test that we're currently running is not the best for stability, it is one of the best solutions for resolving as many bugs as quickly as possible. This is the standard setting for what Atlas would've been used for, regardless of how much testing we did prior to release.

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body: Very well said. +1 I 100% agree that people are going to start leaving because of temporary issues, and as dumb as that sounds, it's true. There needs to be some sort of restriction or sorry message when you join saying "Hey, the lag and glitches will be fixed soon. Please be patient." or at least something similar to this. I don't even play games at this point from lag, but I would like to see some things be added back and/or deleted. As well as some more confirmation on what is actually happening. I know there are lots of glitches and problems that the devs are working hard to fix but answering questions and assuring people that Avicus isn't staying like this should a high priority as well.
